selection_rule.metric: val std-MSE: per-window d=raw input pstdev (fallback rule), mean_12 steps; per-var mean then var-equal mean
selection_rule.best_ft: min val MSE over epochs 1-10, ties -> earlier epoch
selection_rule.selected_with_fallback: adds epoch 0; tie tol = 1e-8 * max(1, earlier candidate MSE); earlier (incl. epoch 0) preferred on tie; fallback_to_zeroshot flagged separately, never merged into main table
